$doc: Browser capability config. The relay DO bridges agent CDP commands to either the user's real logged-in Chrome (via the extension relay, free-tier) or Cloudflare's managed headless Chromium (@cloudflare/playwright binding, paid plan). The vision flag lives in llm-config.json (it's a model property); this file holds the relay/runtime knobs.

relay.$doc: WebSocket relay between the agent and the browser extension.

managed.$doc: Managed headless target (@cloudflare/playwright). Only used if the BROWSER env binding is present (paid Workers plan). Lazily created on first use; one session reused across calls within a relay instance lifetime.

safety.$doc: Credentials NEVER touch our system. The agent assumes the user is already logged in via the relay target. observe() detects login walls and STOPS — it never attempts login itself.
